texts.zh:
[From.GetName]是一颗生态丰富的热带星球。对其表面植被的近距离分析却表明其生物异常缺乏多样性，一种特殊的高大树木成为了生态系统的主体部分。

虽说这种树木本身并不会造成什么危害，但其单一的主导地位却会对该星球小型动物的生存带来不利影响，若要进行殖民，想在其表面有效率地培育农作物也会异常困难。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]作为享有盛誉的外星生物学专家，制定了重新平衡此星球生态系统的计划。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is a tropical planet with a thriving biosphere. A close analysis of surface flora reveals an unexpected lack of diversity, as one particular family of tall trees dominate the ecosystem.

Though not harmful in and of themselves, their monocultural hegemony appears to have a detrimental effect on the survivability of the planet's small animals, and it would be difficult to efficiently cultivate food crops on the surface should colonization ever be attempted.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], a xeno-biologist of some repute, has put together a plan for re-balancing this alien biosphere.

texts.zh: 平衡已恢复了——或许是首次达到了。[Root.GetName]的放射射线消除了长久以来覆盖了这颗星球的那些多年生木本植物的繁殖能力。还有一些树木被彻底烧成了灰烬，以求尽快达到真正的平衡。
texts.en: Balance has been restored - or perhaps achieved for the first time - as large swathes of the dominant perennials have been rendered infertile by targeted radiation emissions from the [Root.GetName]. Additional specimens have been reduced to ash to further hasten the arrival of a truer equilibrium.

texts.zh:
激进地消灭一直以来覆盖着[From.From.GetName]的树木造成了意想不到的后果。

之前被这些树木搞得生计艰难的小动物们数量急剧上升，也越发富有攻击意愿——或者说是变得更加野蛮了。被隔离开来的焦土曾是茂密森林的所在，现在却成了领地争端的战场。
texts.en:
The inelegant elimination of wide swathes of the dominant trees on [From.From.GetName] have had unintended consequences.

The small animals that previously suffered under the perennial tyranny of the trees are growing both more plentiful and more aggressive - some would say savage. The isolated ashen fields that used to be home to lush forests now play host to heated territory battles.

label.zh: 也许我们本不该介入的。
label.en: Perhaps we should have known better than to meddle.

texts.zh:
有一个仅用标准科研船上的设备就能使星球上失衡生态圈恢复平衡的方案被设计了出来。

也许会造成无法预见的后果。
texts.en:
A plan has been formulated to attempt to balance the planet's lopsided biosphere using only the tools available to a standard Science Ship.

There may be unforeseen consequences.
